scope: Finite cutoff and fixed positive floor for the hash-pinned L=16 A1 six-real production model; common real-even mutually orthogonal one-shot sharp shells; bounded cylindrical strict-past controls, or sufficiently integrable regular controls for which every displayed product is finite. theorem.current_factorisation: With P=M_X^2+10^-12, a=9/(500P), b=3/(400P), c=3/(320P), alpha=c/(b+c)=5/9, and q=10/9=2alpha, the production current quadratic form is c0|dm|^2+c1 d^(10/9)|d(m d^(-5/9))|^2 before the physical outer factor 1/2.
theorem.npc_cone: After the exact radial change, the aggregate three-current metric is dR^2+R^2[(113/32)dOmega^2+(25/32)dz^2]; its smooth sectional curvatures are nonpositive, its base has the required CAT(1) closed-geodesic diagnostic, and the standard angle-clipped metric cone is CAT(0).
theorem.strong_jacobi: For the regular geodesic interpolation, R_j=F_j+J_j with J_j at least one half of the spatial L2 norm squared of the gradient of the target distance.
theorem.injection_telescope: The raw secants satisfy E sum_j R_j=E E_J^raw-E E_(j0-1)^raw-E sum_j I_j with I_j nonnegative. Terminal raw energy and injected raw energy cancel exactly at zero control and therefore cannot be bounded separately.
theorem.shellwise_no_go: A strictly positive-floor trigonometric witness has a positive retained square but a negative full production secant. Thus shellwise secant or Jacobi positivity is false even away from the cone tip.
theorem.isolated_resonances: The adapted zero-floor 1:2 and 1:3 harmonic losses complete against Cameron-Martin cost at shell powers -5 and -9 after three-dimensional multiplicity; these isolated mechanisms are summable and do not refute the global production theorem.
theorem.bare_npc_boundary: A flat CAT(0) one-shot reset model with equal target coupling has a negative objective linear in the number of shells even with an additive coordinate sextic. Hence CAT(0), strict-past one-use, and endpoint positivity alone cannot prove the production bound.
theorem.closed_reduction: The old averaged raw-current gate is reduced, not closed: the only viable successor must couple the nonnegative geodesic Jacobi square to the causally harvestable Gaussian injection through production Fourier/Cameron-Martin decay.
theorem.remaining_form: A nonlinear NPC-Carleson or paradifferential estimate must reconcile geodesic logarithms, which spread Fourier support, with the sharp-shell source-square Carleson structure, while retaining the positive Jacobi square.
